<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

GLM-5.3-Flash can fail during MTP verification with TP4/EP4 MegaMoE when Decode CUDA Graph is disabled. MoE pads the token tensors, while attention metadata still describes the valid verification sequences. For example, one 6-token verification sequence is padded to 8 rows.

This mismatch causes KDA verification to fail when reshaping QKV. After correcting that path, DSA KPool verification also fails at `assert bn % num_draft_tokens == 0` because it includes the extra padding rows.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Use the logical verification length from attention metadata to trim KDA QKV and gate inputs before convolution and state updates. Restore zero padding in the output to preserve the downstream tensor layout. Keep the ragged verification path unchanged.
- Restrict DSA KPool key, score, and cache-location writes to the token rows covered by the verification write plan.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Validated on 4×H200 with GLM-5.3-Flash, BF16 KV, TileLang DSA, MegaMoE, and MTP 5/1/6.

### Reproduction and validation command

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 sglang serve \
  --model-path /path/to/GLM-5.3-Flash \
  --served-model-name llm \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 4 \
  --ep-size 4 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 \
  --max-mamba-cache-size 240 \
  --max-running-requests 48 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 8192 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill 8192 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-decode disabled \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 48 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang \
  --dsa-decode-backend tilelang \
  --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
  --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm \
  --moe-a2a-backend megamoe \
  --speculative-moe-runner-backend deep_gemm \
  --speculative-moe-a2a-backend none \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
  --speculative-num-steps 5 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 \
  --reasoning-parser glm45 \
  --tool-call-parser glm47 \
  --random-seed 42 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8090
```

Before the fix, this configuration fails during startup warmup. After the fix, startup and requests at concurrency 1/3/7/19 pass. The same request checks also pass with `--cuda-graph-backend-decode full`.

### Full GSM8K evaluation

```bash
python -m sglang.test.run_eval \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 8090 \
  --api chat \
  --eval-name gsm8k \
  --num-examples 1319 \
  --num-shots 5 \
  --num-threads 8 \
  --repeat 2 \
  --max-tokens 4096 \
  --temperature 0.0 \
  --chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning_effort": "low"}' \
  --gsm8k-data-path /path/to/gsm8k/test.jsonl
```

The evaluator uses 5 examples as demonstrations and scores the remaining 1,314 examples per repeat. Scores below are the two-repeat means.

| Configuration | GSM8K |
| --- | ---: |
| Before fix, Decode Graph enabled | 96.12% |
| After fix, Decode Graph enabled | 95.70% |
| After fix, Decode Graph disabled | 95.97% |

All post-fix evaluations completed without the verification errors above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

This is a correctness fix. No dedicated throughput benchmark was run. Mean GSM8K evaluation time per repeat with Decode Graph enabled was 206.03 seconds before the fix and 204.99 seconds after the fix.

files.patch:
@@ -1591,19 +1591,24 @@ def _forward_cuda_target_verify(
         buf = pool.get_index_k_with_scale_buffer(layer_id=layer_id)
 
         def _compress_write() -> None:
+            # Only rows covered by the write plan belong to verify sequences;
+            # trailing MoE padding must not update per-request KPool state.
+            num_write_tokens = plan.req.shape[0] * num_draft_tokens
             kpool_write_tail_and_maybe_compress(
                 pool=pool,
                 buf=buf,
-                key=key,
-                score=self._compute_gate_score_if_missing(x, gate_score_maybe),
+                key=key[:num_write_tokens],
+                score=self._compute_gate_score_if_missing(x, gate_score_maybe)[
+                    :num_write_tokens
+                ],
                 tail_k=tail_k_buf,
                 tail_score=tail_score_buf,
                 ape=self.index_kpool_compress_ape,
                 req_pool_indices=plan.req,
                 write_start=plan.write_start,
                 tail_logical_start=plan.tail_logical_start,
                 write_loc=plan.write_loc,
-                out_cache_loc=forward_batch.out_cache_loc,
+                out_cache_loc=forward_batch.out_cache_loc[:num_write_tokens],
                 num_draft_tokens=num_draft_tokens,
                 round_scale=self.scale_fmt is not None,
                 effective_n_per_batch=plan.effective_n_per_batch,

@@ -828,7 +828,27 @@ def forward_extend(
         # MTP / speculative-decode verify is a multi-token-per-seq path with
         # per-step state checkpointing + central rollback; handled separately.
         if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify():
-            return self._forward_target_verify(layer, forward_batch, mixed_qkv, a, b)
+            physical_num_tokens = mixed_qkv.shape[0]
+            logical_num_tokens = physical_num_tokens
+            if forward_batch.spec_info.ragged_verify_layout is None:
+                # MoE may append token padding that is not a complete verify
+                # sequence. Keep it out of convolution and state updates.
+                logical_num_tokens = (
+                    self.forward_metadata.query_start_loc.shape[0] - 1
+                ) * forward_batch.spec_info.draft_token_num
+                mixed_qkv = mixed_qkv[:logical_num_tokens]
+                a = a[:, :logical_num_tokens]
+                b = b[:, :logical_num_tokens]
+            core_attn_out = self._forward_target_verify(
+                layer, forward_batch, mixed_qkv, a, b
+            )
+            if logical_num_tokens < physical_num_tokens:
+                pad = core_attn_out.new_zeros(
+                    (1, physical_num_tokens - logical_num_tokens)
+                    + tuple(core_attn_out.shape[2:])
+                )
+                core_attn_out = torch.cat((core_attn_out, pad), dim=1)
+            return core_attn_out
 
         query_start_loc = self.forward_metadata.query_start_loc
         cache_indices = self.forward_metadata.mamba_cache_indices
